TSEM is a silicon-photonics foundry-capacity proxy rather than a module or laser vendor; include only if later evidence confirms AI optical-engine customer contracts, scarce capacity, and meaningful revenue contribution.

summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the optical-interconnect-materials node. The cleanest direct exposures are optical component leaders Coherent and Lumentum, but the underfollowed lane is more interesting around AXT as a relatively pure InP substrate supplier and Tower Semiconductor as a silicon-photonics foundry capacity proxy. This pass intentionally avoids overfilling with AI mega-cap customers and treats them only as demand-context anchors.
